Summary Nuveen Churchill Direct Lending is rated HOLD, with a 12.4% covered yield and a deep discount to NAV reflecting credit concerns. NCDL trades at 0.711× NAV and 7.45× NII, with the market pricing in more damage than current stress scenarios support. Credit quality is deteriorating: non-accruals doubled to 2.66%, and the watch list has risen for seven consecutive quarters, but dividend coverage improved to 1.08× after a proactive cut.
